overview: A trading journal that logs trades with direction-aware thesis and counter-thesis, captures trades from TradingView via Chrome extension, and lets you speak trades freely into a universal AI voice mic that routes your words into the right fields.
features: Direction-aware thesis and counter-thesis labels that adapt to long or short trades
Human-readable dropdown values throughout the app
Chrome extension that captures symbol, direction, prices, size, P&L, and notes from TradingView into a clean draft
Universal AI voice mic that transcribes free speech and routes it into the correct form fields for review
Per-entry shareable URLs for every journal trade
Existing sidebar, journal list, dashboard, and analytics preserved
